# dsh-plugin-backup

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A backup plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it packages `$DSH_HOME` into verifiable,
restorable, downloadable archives by category, and can mirror those backups to
GitHub. Everything is available from three faces that share one engine and one
single-run lock: the **Web settings page**, the **model tool surface**, and a
**CLI session**.

- Naming: `dsh-backup-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHmmss>`
- Categories: `settings`, `skills`, `plugins`, `sessions`, `storages`
- Per backup: **download / verify / restore / delete**
- Settings: **backup path**, **backup interval**, per-category switches, retention count,
  verify-after-create, per-category archive ceiling, GitHub sync
- No build step and no third-party runtime dependency: the host half is plain ESM,
  the browser half is a hand-writable CommonJS factory the shell loads as-is

## Install

```powershell
# local checkout (development)
dsh plugin --profile web add file:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-backup

# or from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shiinakaze/dsh-plugin-backup
```

The Desktop app manages its own `desktop` profile: install through its plugin
manager (or `dsh plugin --profile desktop add …`) and restart the app.

`dsh plugin add` both records the dependency and appends the package name to
`dsh.profile.bundles` (one composition layer). Reload or restart the Web
interface afterwards, then open **Settings → Data backup**.

> **Runtime support.** The plugin targets the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.7 and 0.2.0
> lines: `peerDependencies` declare `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` for `dsh-tools`
> and `dsh-typert-protocol`, and `engines.dsh` mirrors that window. This matters
> on 0.2.0, whose boot performs a compatibility preflight against the running
> runtime and **refuses to install or mount a bundle whose dsh peers it cannot
> satisfy** — an exact pin to one rc would be rejected. The two branches are not
> cosmetic: package managers resolve with npm's prerelease rule, under which a
> prerelease is admitted only when some comparator pins its exact version tuple,
> so one `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0` window silently drops `0.2.0-rc.1` and
> `0.2.0-rc.2` and fails `npm install` with `ERESOLVE`. Keep the window in
> `package.json` in step with the APIs the plugin actually uses.

> A `file:` install is a **snapshot**: the profile keeps its own copy, so after
> changing this package's source you must `dsh plugin --profile web remove <name>`
> and add it again. The measured verification log lives in
> [docs/verify.md](docs/verify.md).

> This is a DSH plugin, not a plain dependency: the host half injects the `tools`
> service declared in its schema, and the browser half is discovered through the
> `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json`. Without `$DSH_HOME` the plugin falls
> back to `~/.dsh`; in a non-Web profile (no `webServer` service) only *download*
> is unavailable — every other feature and tool still works.

## The page

Settings → **Data backup**:

| Block | Contents |
|---|---|
| Backup settings | Backup path (empty = `C:\Users\<user>\dsh_backups` on Windows, `~/dsh_backups` elsewhere; `~` and `${DSH_HOME}` are expanded), interval (off / 15 min / hourly / 6 h / daily / weekly), backups to keep, verify right after creating |
| Backup categories | The **selection** for a run: check the categories to include, with select-all / select-none; the button names the current choice ("Back up now (3 categories)") and is disabled with a hint while nothing is selected |
| Existing backups | Per row: id, creation time, file count, size, category tags, last verdict; actions are a **download** menu (one category or the manifest), **verify**, **preview restore**, **restore**, and **delete** (restore and delete take a second click to confirm; delete is the destructive-colored one) |
| GitHub sync | Enable switch, `owner/repo`, branch, subdirectory, token environment variable, whether a token was detected, and **push / pull** |

"Back up now" covers only the checked categories; saving the settings also makes that
selection the default for scheduled runs.

Settings are written to the plugin's own user layer at
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugin-backup/settings.json` (`0600`); the deployment baseline stays
in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and the two are shallow-merged (user wins).

## Layout on disk

```
<backupPath>/
  dsh-backup-20260930-141205/
    manifest.json           # schema version, host facts, per-category files/bytes/sha256/archive, last verdict
    settings.tar.gz         # one gzipped USTAR archive per category
    skills.tar.gz
    plugins.tar.gz
```

The manifest is written last and atomically, so "a directory with a manifest" is a
complete backup. Intermediate files carry a `.part` suffix while a run is in
flight; residue from a crash is cleaned up or ignored at the start of the next run.

## Categories and exclusions

| key | Sources (relative to `$DSH_HOME`) | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `settings` | `settings.yaml*`, `cordis.patch.yml*`, `.credentials.yaml*`, `.anonymous-user-id`, `dsh-skill-hub.json`, `skills-market-sync.json` | on |
| `skills` | `skills-management/**` | on |
| `plugins` | `profiles/*/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `cordis.patch.yml*`, plus `plugins/**` | on |
| `sessions` | `sessions/**` | off |
| `storages` | `storages/**` | off |

Always excluded: `node_modules` and `.git*` at any depth, symbolic links, and the
backup root itself — so keeping the store inside `$DSH_HOME` never recurses.

### Measured on a real harness home (`settings` + `plugins` + `skills`)

| Category | Files | Raw | Archive | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings` | 5 | 2.0 KB | 1.3 KB | < 0.1 s |
| `plugins` | 39 | 1.24 MB | 1.12 MB | 0.2 s |
| `skills` | 29 356 | 342.5 MB | 144.8 MB | ≈ 50 s |

Creation and verification are streaming (flat memory; measured RSS went 57 MB →
158 MB), so a category is never held in memory. That is why the default ceiling is
**512 MiB**: a realistic skills tree already passes 100 MiB compressed. Raise
`maxArchiveBytes` in the settings if yours is larger, or leave `skills` out and
back it up by hand. With retention 20 and `skills` enabled the store can reach ~3 GB.

## GitHub sync

1. Enable sync on the settings page and fill in `owner/repo` (a full URL also works),
   the branch, and the subdirectory.
2. Token resolution, in order:
   - an environment variable — `DSH_BACKUP_GITHUB_TOKEN` by default (renameable in settings);
   - the state file `$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugin-backup/github-token.json` holding `{"token": "…"}`, mode `0600`.
   The token is read from nowhere else and never written to config, logs, or tool output.
3. **Push** uploads file by file through the Contents API, archives first and
   `manifest.json` last; a backup the remote already holds with the same content is
   skipped. **Pull** downloads only the backups missing locally and verifies every
   archive against the sha256 in its manifest — a mismatch discards that backup and
   reports why.

Remote layout: `<subdir>/<backupId>/{manifest.json,<category>.tar.gz}`.

## Model tools

| Tool | Parameters | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `backup_run` | `categories?`, `label?` | Create a backup now |
| `backup_list` | `limit?` | List backups, newest first |
| `backup_verify` | `id` | Recompute sha256 and re-read the tar structure, per category |
| `backup_restore` | `id`, `categories?`, `dryRun?`, `force?` | Restore; `dryRun` only reports the plan |
| `backup_delete` | `id`, `force?` | Delete; the newest backup is protected while an older one exists |
| `backup_sync` | `direction`, `ids?` | Push to or pull from GitHub |

A typical loop: `backup_run` before a risky change, then `backup_verify` and
`backup_restore` afterwards. `backup_restore` verifies first and refuses a corrupt
backup unless `force` is set.

## Safety boundaries

| Situation | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Path traversal | Backup ids must match `^dsh-backup-\d{8}-\d{6}$`; archive entries refuse absolute paths, drive letters, and `..` |
| Corruption | `verify` names the category and the expected/actual sha256; `restore` refuses by default and, under `force`, skips that category and reports it |
| Irrevers

# dsh-opencode-go-catalog

A live-maintained OpenCode Go model catalog for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). Membership is rebuilt from the live roster plus the docs endpoint table on every sync — new
models appear, retired ones drop out, no hand work. A curated snapshot stays as the offline fallback.

**Status:** 0.2.0 · auto membership · 33 models live (2026-10-13), incl. **Cat Jam Free** (`cat-jam-free`)

## Contents

- [Why](#why)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Commands & scripts](#commands--scripts)
- [Fresh reasoning efforts](#fresh-reasoning-efforts)
- [The protocol oracle](#the-protocol-oracle)
- [Maintaining the catalog](#maintaining-the-catalog)
- [Enable / disable](#enable--disable)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Security](#security)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [License & sources](#license--sources)

## Why

The built-in `opencode-go` route of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` serves a static catalog shipped in
`@earendil-works/pi-ai` (30 models at the time of writing) that never refreshes itself — new models
like Step 5 or Cat Jam are missing until upstream bumps the dependency. See
[Discussion #3957](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3957).

This plugin never touches the built-in route. It manages three sibling routes through the
official `settings.mutate` seam:

| Route | Protocol | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-extras` | `openai-completions` | Cat Jam Free, Step 5 Preview Free, GLM-5.3, LongCat, MiMo, Kimi, DeepSeek |
| `opencode-go-responses` | `openai-responses` | GPT-5.6/6 Luna, Grok 4.6/4.7, Muse Spark 1.2/1.3 |
| `opencode-go-messages` | `anthropic-messages` | Claude Haiku 5.5, Qwen3.8, MiniMax M2.7/M3 |

The split is mandatory, not stylistic: some Go models are *Responses-only* (a chat-completions
request answers with a bare `500` or `401 "not supported for format oa-compat"`), others are
*Messages-only*. One route = one protocol.

**Why not put the extra models on the built-in route?** Source-verified against `dsh-llm-pi-ai`:
`resolveRouteModels` computes a model's protocol as `request.api ?? base?.api ?? routeApi` — an
`api` field *on a model entry* is never read. A model the shipped catalog does not describe
therefore needs the **route-level** `api`, and setting that routes `opencode-go` through
`createProvider()` over a *single* protocol (the catalog provider is only reused while
`spec.api === undefined`), losing both the three-protocol dispatch and pi-ai's session-header
wrapper. On top of that, any `models` list *replaces* the served catalog. The built-in route stays
untouched.

## How it works

1. **Registry** — `https://models.opencode.ai/api.json` (keyless, ETag cache + last-good fallback)
   supplies name, limits, input modalities, and `reasoning_options` per model.
2. **Roster** — `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models` (keyless) says which IDs exist *right now*.
3. **Protocol oracle** — `https://opencode.ai/docs/go/` carries an endpoint table per model ID
   (`…/go/v1/chat/completions`, `/responses`, `/messages`). See
   [The protocol oracle](#the-protocol-oracle).
4. Membership is then `roster ∩ registry ∩ protocol-known`, minus the veto list. On startup, on an
   interval (default 4 h), and on `/opencode-go-sync` the three sibling routes are written via
   `settings.mutate`.
5. **Fail-safe.** The auto mode refuses to write, and the curated snapshot in `catalog/models.json`
   is served unchanged, when
   - the roster or the oracle is unavailable (network, docs redesign), or
   - fewer than `minAutoModels` models resolve, or
   - fewer than `minAutoRatio` (default 60 %) of the last adopted set resolve — this catches a
     *degraded* source that would otherwise quietly empty half the picker and stamp the missing IDs
     as retired.

   A single route that comes out empty is not fatal either: `llm-pi-ai` rejects a route with
   `resolves no models`, and because all three routes go into one `settings.mutate`, one empty group
   would block the healthy groups too — so that route is served from the snapshot and reported in
   `status.json` (`auto.snapshotRoutes`). A network outage or a docs redesign can therefore never
   empty the picker. Missing capacities are never invented — the field is omitted and `needsReview`
   is reported, so `llm-pi-ai` applies its own route defaults (262144 / 32768).
6. The module never throws during boot, never edits `node_modules`, and never reads or writes
   credentials (it only references the `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` name, same as the built-in route).

**Hand-added models do not survive.** `settings.mutate` persists into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`, and each sibling route is written as one whole object. A model you add by hand
(or via Settings → Models → *Fetch available models* → *Add model*) inside one of these three routes
is gone at the next sync — startup, interval, or `/opencode-go-sync`. Durable entries belong in the
snapshot (`node bin/sync.mjs --adopt`) or in the veto list.

## Installation

Prerequisites: DSH running, an OpenCode Go subscription with a working key
(`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` already configured — if the built-in `opencode-go` route works, you are set).

**Via Plugin Market** (once listed): Settings → Plugin Market → search
`dsh-opencode-go-catalog` → one-click install → restart → open the model picker.
Expect three new groups (*OpenCode Go extras / responses / messages*) next to the built-in one.

**Manual**: copy this folder to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-opencode-go-catalog`, add
`"dsh-opencode-go-catalog"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile `package.json` (keep a backup
first), restart DSH.

**Without the plugin** (static, no auto-refresh): generate the snippet and replace your
`llm-pi-ai` row with it — see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) and [weg-a-schnellstart.yml](weg-a-schnellstart.yml):

```sh
node bin/snippet.mjs > snippet.yml
```

## Configuration

Bundle row ([cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), replaces the whole row — no deep merge):

```yaml
- id: opencode-go-catalog
  name: dsh-opencode-go-catalog
  config:
    enabled: true            # false → sibling routes are removed again
    autoMembership: true     # false → curated snapshot only, no roster/oracle
    minAutoModels: 8         # safety belt: below this the snapshot is served
    minProtocolRows: 10      # safety belt against a docs redesign
    minAutoRatio: 0.6        # safety belt against a degraded (not dead) source; 0 disables it
    refreshReasoning: true   # false → snapshot values only, no network (this also disables auto mode)
    sessionHeaderValue: 'dsh-opencode-go-catalog'  # false → no static session header (400 risk)
    intervalMinutes: 240     # 0 → startup only
    startupDelaySeconds: 10
    refreshTimeoutMs: 120000
    catalogPath: ./catalog/models.json
    managedRoutes:
      - opencode-go-extras
      - opencode-go-responses
      - opencode-go-messages
```

## Commands & scripts

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/opencode-go-sync` (chat) | Immediate rewrite from the live sources. Registered through `ctx.root` into the global command layer, so it appears in the `/` menu for every session (registering through the plugin fiber context lands outside all agent scope chains: self-probe green, menu empty — fixed in 0.1.4) |
| `node bin/sync.mjs` (default) | Report: field diffs, new live IDs with their protocol, dead IDs — writes nothing |
| `node bin/sync.mjs --auto` | Preview what the auto mode would publish (per route, added, removed, unresolved). Uses the default safety belts — a non-default `minAutoModels`/`minAutoRatio`/`minProtocolRows` in the profile patch can make the host decide differently |
| `node bin/sync.mjs --adopt` | Write the live membership into the snapshot (fallback stays current) |
| `node bin/sync.mjs --write` | Rewrite snapshot fields from the registry + stamp the date |
| `node bin/sync.mjs --check` | Offline snapshot rule check |
| `node bin/snippet.mjs` | Print the complete `llm-pi-ai` replacement row for manual installs |
| `node verify.mjs` | Manifest + patch shape + catalog rules

plugins.description: Onto space panel for DeepSeek Harness: declarations, agents, memory and per-chat context.
plugins.readme_text:
# Onto Space Panel for DeepSeek Harness

A compact Onto space picker and a side panel for declarations, resident agents,
memory artifacts, templates and objects. Select what belongs in the current chat;
the active context remains visible above the composer.

## Features

- Connect to Onto on first use: enter your MCP endpoint and API key, verify
  access, then select a space. Reuse an existing Harness connection automatically.
- Search and select available Onto spaces.
- Open the space panel with **Обзор**.
- Read an accepted/current space declaration and attach it to the chat.
- Inspect resident agents and their charters. Selecting a valid active resident
  loads its accepted charter and constitution into the current chat.
- Search and page through accepted memory artifacts, read their contents and
  explicitly attach or disconnect them.
- Browse templates and objects, then include selected objects in the conversation.
- Keep selections and context separate for each chat and each selected realm.
- Change context through the `select_onto_space` and
  `configure_onto_chat_context` model tools when the user requests it.

The UI is currently in Russian. Names and descriptions are supplied by Onto.
An agent selection gives the current Harness conversation a resident role;
it does not launch a separate agent process or external agent broker.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with its Web UI or Desktop application.
- Your Onto MCP endpoint URL and personal API key, or an existing authenticated
  Harness MCP connection named **`onto`**.
- Harness's writable credential provider for the first-use setup form. Standard
  local profiles use `@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials-local`.
- The connection must expose `list_available_realms`, `about_realm`,
  `list_realm_agents`, `get_realm_agent`, `search_memory_artifacts`,
  `get_memory_artifact`, `get_memory_artifact_by_path`, `search_templates`,
  `search_objects` and `get_entity` for their respective panel features.

Host integration was developed against DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**.
Other releases are not yet verified. Harness is in developer preview and its
extension interfaces can change.

## Install a release tarball

Download the package `.tgz` from the project's release and install it into a
Web-capable profile. For example:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-onto-space-panel-1.2.1.tgz
```

Release downloads: https://github.com/hope4b/dsh-onto-space-panel/releases

You can also install the tagged GitHub source, which already contains the built
browser entry point and has no install-time build script:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hope4b/dsh-onto-space-panel#v1.2.1
```

In Desktop, use **Plugins** to install the downloaded bundle where supported by
your version. The tarball already contains the browser bundle; no install-time
build script or extra build permission is needed.

If this plugin was previously loaded manually by an absolute-path row in
`cordis.patch.yml`, disable that old row before enabling the packaged bundle.
Do not run two copies: they register the same tools and API routes.

Restart Harness after installing or replacing the bundle. Select an Onto space
above the composer and press **Обзор** to open its panel. Use **В контекст** to
attach a declaration or memory artifact. A role or material can be removed using
the `×` next to its context label.

## Connect Onto MCP

### First-use setup (recommended)

1. Install the plugin and restart Harness.
2. Click **Onto → Подключить** above the composer.
3. Enter your MCP endpoint URL and personal API key, then press **Подключить**.
   The key field expects only the value. A pasted `X-Onto-Api-Key: value` line
   is accepted too: the plugin removes the header name before sending or storing it.
4. The plugin checks access with `list_available_realms` before saving. After
   success, select a space from the list. An empty list means the connection
   works but no accessible spaces were returned.

Obtain the endpoint and key from your Onto administrator. The form uses HTTPS
and the `X-Onto-Api-Key` header; localhost HTTP is supported for development.
It requires a direct MCP endpoint, without credentials or query parameters in
the URL. Authentication redirects are rejected.

The connection belongs to the active Harness profile. Keys are stored through
Harness's credential provider, not in plugin configuration, browser storage or
chat messages. With the standard local provider, the managed credential file is
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`. This is local credential storage, not a claim of
OS keychain encryption. The server address and credential reference are stored
under `$DSH_HOME/storages/onto-connections/`, keyed by the profile location.
The plugin restores its own MCP connection on startup without editing profile YAML.

Open **Подключение** in the space picker, or **Подключение Onto** in the side
panel, to update a connection created by the plugin. A blank key reuses the saved
key only when the endpoint stays the same. Changing the endpoint or account key
requires choosing spaces and attaching context again; old chat context is not
automatically applied to the new connection.

If Harness already provides a server named `onto`, the plugin reuses it and
skips onboarding. Those external settings remain managed in Harness; the panel
does not overwrite or migrate that connection. A configured but unavailable
connection is shown as configured, with errors when loading spaces.

### Manual Harness configuration (fallback)

Use this when your deployment manages MCP centrally or does not provide a writable
credential provider. If the profile already has an Onto connection, do not add
a second one.

1. Obtain your Onto **MCP endpoint URL** and personal API key from your Onto
   administrator. Use the MCP endpoint, not the ordinary Onto website URL.
2. Open the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: normally
   `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` for Web or
   `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` for Windows Desktop.
   A custom `DSH_HOME` changes the `.dsh` location.
3. Append the following patch, replacing the placeholder URL. If an Onto entry
   already exists, update it instead of creating a duplicate. The server name
   must be exactly `onto`.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-onto
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: onto
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://YOUR-ONTO-MCP-HOST/mcp
        headers:
          X-Onto-Api-Key: !!js process.env.ONTO_API_KEY
```

This example uses Onto's `X-Onto-Api-Key` header. Confirm the authentication
scheme with your server administrator if your deployment differs.
A copy is available in [examples/onto-mcp.patch.yml](examples/onto-mcp.patch.yml).

4. Set `ONTO_API_KEY` in the environment of the process that starts Harness.
   For Web on Windows, start it from the same PowerShell window:

```powershell
$env:ONTO_API_KEY = 'YOUR_PERSONAL_API_KEY'
dsh --profile web
```

For Windows Desktop, fully quit Harness first, set the variable above, then
launch the executable from that same PowerShell window. For the default installer
location:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
```

Launching via an existing desktop shortcut does not inherit a variable set only
in this PowerShell window. The variable must be available on every launch.
Enter your real key locally; do not commit it or share terminal history containing it.

5. Open the space selector above the composer. Your accessible spaces should
   appear. You can also ask the model to call `mcp__onto__list_available_realms`.

If connection fails, check the endpoint and network access first. A `401` or
`403` response usually indicates authentication or access rights. If the tools
work in chat but the panel cannot find them, check that `serverName` is `onto`.
Missing agent or memory tools affect those sections separately; an empty list
can also mean your account has no access to those resources.

The transport and environment-variable syntax follow the official
[Harness MCP client configuration](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepse

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 挂一个烧心体人格：改 Markdown 就是改人格，保存即生效。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-persona-shaoxin

**给 DeepSeek Harness 挂一个"擦不锈钢桌子的老实摊主"人格——烧心体。改 Markdown 就是改人格，保存即生效。**

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mycatqiezi/dsh-persona-shaoxin)

已收录于 [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mycatqiezi/dsh-persona-shaoxin)（status: verified）。

## 装完有什么变化

同一件事，两种说法：

| 普通写法 | 挂上之后 |
|---|---|
| 我们的定价稍高，主要是因为选用了品质更好的原材料 | 贵是贵点。但吃了不烧心。 |
| 面对同行的低价策略，我们会坚持品质定位 | 怕亏钱吗？怕。**但更怕坏规矩。** |
| 我们对这批不合格产品进行了报废处理 | 剩下怎么办？**倒掉。** |

每条回答走六幕节奏：钩子 → 打压 → 升级 → 反击 → 留钩子，**绝不给圆满结局**。单句不超过 15 个字。

## 特性

- **文件驱动**：人格写在 md 里，不在代码里。六件套 `SOUL / IDENTITY / USER / LINES / MEMORY / TOOLS`。
- **改完即生效**：`fs.watch` 防抖 150ms 自动重挂载，不用重启 dsh。
- **台词库**：`LINES.md` 是一整套可被直接调用的素材——招牌句、四大句式填空模板、万能替换词表、二字段、反例对照。换【货】就长出一部新剧。
- **项目级覆盖**：`<项目根>/.dsh/persona/*.md` 同名覆盖全局，没放的仍读全局。
- **零构建**：纯 JS ESM，无 TypeScript、无 `prepare` 脚本 → 自动安装，**不会触发 `--allow-build` 授权**。
- **安全兜底**：挂载时扫描 `{{…}}` 模板语法并告警，防止提示词变量严格插值把 session 干掉。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MycatQieZi/dsh-persona-shaoxin
```

支持的 profile：`web`（其他 profile 需自行验证 `systemPrompt` 服务是否可用）。安装后重启 dsh web 生效。

## 用法（最小示例）

**1. 放人设文件**

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/persona
cp persona/*.md ~/.dsh/persona/
```

**2. 改你想改的那句**

```
~/.dsh/persona/LINES.md
  贵是贵点，但用了不烧心。
```

保存，150ms 后自动生效。发下一条消息就是新人格。

**3. 让它写剧本**

> 写一个 45 秒的烧心体短剧，卖的东西是纳鞋底。

它会给你进场钩子、压迫感、反转、以及一句能截图的收尾。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-persona-shaoxin/
├── index.js            插件入口：apply(ctx, config)
├── cordis.patch.yml    安装时贡献的配置层
├── package.json        dsh.bundle 声明
├── persona/            人设本体（改这里）
│   ├── SOUL.md         行为准则：三条铁律、四大句式、六幕节奏、禁止清单
│   ├── IDENTITY.md     身份：擦不锈钢桌子的老实摊主
│   ├── USER.md         用户：写短剧的人，要能直接用的台词
│   ├── LINES.md        台词库（核心资产）
│   ├── MEMORY.md       长期记忆
│   └── TOOLS.md        环境备忘
└── samples/
    └── before-after.md  六种场景的普通写法 vs 烧心体对照
```

## 配置

改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config`：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `order` | `1` | 落位。官方档位：harness 身份 −1000 / persona 前缀 0 / 计划 500 / 工具指导 1000–3000 / 结构化输出 9900 / persona 后缀 10200 |
| `section` | `deployment:shaoxin` | 别改成 `deployment:persona`，那是 prompt 注册表自己的槽位，同名 loud-fail |
| `files` | 六件套 | 想调淡删掉 `LINES.md`；想调浓把它排到 `SOUL.md` 前面 |
| `maxChars` | `24000` | 截断上限 |
| `watch` | `true` | 关掉就是纯静态，只在加载时读一次 |

## 它是怎么工作的

DSH 在每个模型步骤前由 `dsh-system-prompt` 按 order 拼装系统提示词。插件只要：

```js
export const inject = ['systemPrompt']
const dispose = ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name, order, text })
```

就往提示词里插了一段。`text` 是模板 —— `{{cwd}}` / `{{model}}` 会严格插值，**未注册的变量会报错**，所以本插件在挂载时会把它扫出来告警（用【】做占位符，别用 `{{ }}`）。

## 权限与隐私

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 磁盘读取 | 仅读 `<cwd>/.dsh/persona/` 与 `$DSH_HOME/persona/` 下的 md 文件 |
| 磁盘写入 | 无。（首次运行会 `mkdir` 全局 persona 目录） |
| 网络 | 无任何出站请求，无 telemetry |
| 执行的命令 | 无 |
| 挂载面 | 只注册一个 system-prompt section，不注册工具、不改模型路由、不碰沙箱与审批策略 |

## 兼容性

- **目标 DSH 版本**：0.1.0 系列；依赖 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` ≥ 4.0.4 与 `systemPrompt` 服务契约。
- **状态**：作者尚未在真机 dsh 上完成端到端挂载验证（本机未安装 dsh）。已完成的是**假 ctx 逻辑冒烟**——六文件拼装 4128 字符、section 落位正确、`{{cwd}}` 误写告警如期触发。首个真机反馈欢迎开 Issue。
- DSH 尚在开发者预览期，上游 API 可能 breaking，README 会跟进标注适用区间。

## 梗从哪来

2026 年 AI 市井短剧跑出来的热梗：良心摊主用好料被迫提价 → 隔壁低价黑心同行抢客 → 被嘲笑"不会做生意" → 擦锃亮不锈钢桌甩一句"怕亏钱，但更怕坏规矩" → 黑心店翻车 → 顾客回流一句"贵是贵点，但吃了不烧心"。同一模板换汤不换药，观众从"看剧"变成"背剧"，把它玩成了梗。抖音 #不烧心# 播放超 20 亿。

保留[LINES.md](persona/LINES.md)里的替换词表，下次换梗改三列就行，骨架不用动。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 MycatQieZi

plugins.description: Use your Kimi Code / Grok (X Premium) / Google Antigravity / GLM (BigModel) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers - OAuth sign-in, per-model visibility, drag-to-reorder Auto fallback, and plan quotas from the Settings page. No API keys.
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

# dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth

**Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for as LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness — no API key.**

Sign in once per provider from **Settings → Subscriptions** and that provider's models join the session model picker, with its plan quota shown live next to the connection. Tokens stay on your machine; every request streams through the provider's own API.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth)
[![Licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

## Supported providers

| Provider | What you get | Sign-in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Kimi Code** | `kimi-for-coding`, `k3` (1M), `k3-256k` — read from the endpoint's own model list | OAuth device flow (show code, confirm in browser) |
| **Grok (X Premium)** | whatever the account's own model list reports (e.g. `grok-4.7`), **⚡ lightspeed** fast variant | Browser OAuth (auto-redirect) |
| **Google Antigravity** | Claude Sonnet/Opus, Gemini Flash, GPT-OSS, with reasoning tiers — read from the account's own list | Google account OAuth |
| **GLM (BigModel)** | whatever the coding host lists (e.g. `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`) | ZCode browser sign-in (polled) |
| **Volcengine Ark** | the plan's own coding models | Volcengine SSO |
| **Xiaomi MiMo** | MiMo's own model list, with the app's two-model set as the fallback | Xiaomi account (QR / password) |
| **WorkBuddy (国内版)** | Hy, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax models | Browser OAuth (Tencent) |

Every provider also feeds the **`auto`** route, which spans them all: pick `auto` and the harness walks your enabled models in order until one answers.

## Features

- **One sign-in per provider** — no API keys to find, paste, or rotate. The plugin runs the provider's own OAuth/device flow and keeps the token on disk (`~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json`, mode `0600`).
- **Live plan usage** — the Settings card and the composer chip show each account's remaining quota (Kimi's 5-hour / weekly windows + credit, Grok's weekly credit, Antigravity's Gemini + Claude buckets, GLM/Ark/MiMo/WorkBuddy credits), with a meter and reset time.
- **Model picker integration** — each provider's models appear in the session picker with context windows and reasoning tiers; hide or re-order them per provider.
- **Catalogs come from the provider, not from this build** — every route reads its own model list once and caches it as the provider's table, so a model released, renamed or retired server-side shows up (or disappears) without a plugin update. Signing in and the Settings **refresh models** action are what re-read it; browsing the picker never spends a request.
- **⚡ Fast / lightspeed variants** — for models that have one (e.g. Grok 4.7 → `grok-4.7-build-fast`), a bolt button beside the model selector switches to the fast variant; it reads as a reasoning rung so the base model always stays selectable.
- **Cross-account pool** — sign in to several accounts on one provider; the plugin draws on the next account when one's allowance runs out.
- **Auto fallback** — `auto` moves to the next enabled model when a provider refuses the preferred one (renamed, rate-limited, out of quota), and stops falling back once a stream has started.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness and open **Settings → Subscriptions** (订阅).

To install a specific version, or straight from the repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth@0.10.2
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EricFL1998/dsh-subscription-oauth
```

## How to use

1. **Open Settings → Subscriptions.** You see one card per provider; signed-in providers sort to the front, `auto` leads.
2. **Connect** a provider. A browser window (or a device code) starts the provider's own sign-in. Finish it there — the card updates by itself.
3. **Pick a model.** The provider's models now appear in the composer model picker, and the chip shows live usage.
4. **Expand a card** to manage accounts (set default, sign out, refresh token), toggle which models appear, re-order them, add a model id this build doesn't know yet, and see the credential file / endpoints.

> **Tip:** to use a different account on a provider, sign out first, then connect again — the browser sign-in follows whichever account the provider's page is signed in with.

## What it registers

| Surface | What appears |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.llm` | the `kimi`, `grok`, `antigravity`, `glm`, `ark`, `mimo`, `workbuddy` and `auto` provider routes (models, reasoning, streaming) |
| Settings | a **Subscriptions** section: one card per provider |
| Model picker | each provider's own models, plus **`auto`** spanning them all |
| Composer chip | live plan usage for the provider in force |

## Hiding a provider

To keep a provider's models out of the picker without uninstalling, drop it from the route list in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
plugins:
  dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth:
    providers: [kimi, grok, antigravity, glm, ark, mimo, workbuddy]
```

Omit the ones you don't want. The list defaults to every implemented route.

## Security

- Credentials are stored locally at `~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json` (mode `0600`, written atomically), one section per provider.
- The plugin talks only to the providers' own hosts and OAuth endpoints — no telemetry, no third-party relay.
- Your subscriptions only; nothing is shared across machines.

## Develop

See the [developer README](README.dev.md) for the full wire protocol, token lifetimes, troubleshooting, and how to run the test suite.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-license-guard)


**关键词**：开源许可 · 开源协议 · 许可证合规 · 许可风险 · GPL 传染 · AGPL · 开源合规 · 许可证
**Keywords**: open source license · license compliance · GPL · AGPL · copyleft · license risk
**开源许可合规检查** —— 扫依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险。

发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。退出码可挂 CI。

## 不装它会怎样

你的产物里混进了一个 **GPL 依赖**，你没发现，打包发出去了。

半年后客户审计问：「你用了 GPL 代码，为什么没开源？」——
**GPL 的义务从「分发」那一刻就触发了**，而分发在半年前。

这个检查跑一次几秒钟。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | GPL / AGPL —— 强传染 |
| 🟡 中 | 许可未知（没写许可证 ≠ 随便用）· 项目缺 LICENSE |
| 🟢 低 | LGPL / MPL / EPL · package.json 缺 license 字段 |

## 安装

```bash
# DSH 插件（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard

# 或纯 CLI（不依赖 DSH）
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-license-guard                # 扫当前目录
dsh-license-guard --demo         # 用内置样本看效果
dsh-license-guard --html r.html  # 输出 HTML 报告
```

![dsh-license-guard 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/report.png)

![dsh-license-guard 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/demo.png)

![dsh-license-guard 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/rules.png)

## 覆盖范围

**5 条规则**，覆盖依赖树的许可风险 + 项目基础文件。

**不覆盖**：专利条款、商标、出口管制、SSPL/BUSL 等非 SPDX 自定义协议。
依赖声明的许可证值可能不准（维护者写错），本工具**不校验其真实性**。

## 为什么和其他工具不同

它**不只看依赖**，也看**你自己**：项目缺 LICENSE、package.json 缺 license 字段 ——
这两条会让别人（和你自己的下游）无法判断能不能用你的代码。

## 边界

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

## 开发

```bash
npm install
bash tests/run.sh     # 双向验证（正例必须报 + 反例必须不报）
```

plugins.description: 官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本：10 条自包含补丁 + 自适应应用器（自己找安装位置、逐个备份、语法检查、一键回退），五种打法、零硬编码路径。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Official DSH core patches as data: ten patches plus an adaptive applier. Five ways to apply. DSH 1.5 only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-patch-library

**The official DSH core patches, as data — and five ways to apply them.**

**官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本 —— 10 条补丁，5 种打法。**

Ten self-contained patches for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, plus a small
applier that finds *your* DSH installation by itself. No hard-coded paths, no personal information
anywhere in this repository, no network access required.

十条自成体系的补丁，覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`；配一个小巧的应用器，
它会**自己找到你的 DSH 安装位置**。零硬编码路径、仓库里没有任何个人信息、全程不需要联网。

> 🌐 **中文完整说明（推荐中文读者从这里开始）** → **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**
>
> 中文读者还应该看这两份：[`教程-安装与官方补丁` 里的补丁库章节](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim/blob/main/tutorial-install-and-official-patches.zh-CN.md)
> 与 [给 agent 的中文提示词](PROMPT.zh-CN.md)。

> Built for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2** (the 1.5 line). Every patch records the exact
> sha256 of both the file it expects and the file it produces, so the applier can tell you
> `exact` / `applied` / `conflict` before it touches anything.

---

## Why this repository exists

Some fixes cannot be shipped as a plugin: they have to run *inside* an official file, in the middle
of a function that Cordis does not expose as a seam. Four of those fixes were already published as
plugins (`dsh-context-reclaim`, `dsh-capability-composer`, `dsh-composer-launcher`,
`dsh-aux-degrade`). The rest — plus the ones that only matter if you want the full set — live here,
as ordinary unified diffs that anyone can read, review, apply, revert, or regenerate.

Nothing here is a binary blob and nothing here is magic: `patches/<id>/change.diff` is a normal
patch, and `manifest.json` is the metadata that lets a script apply it safely and reversibly.

## The ten patches

| id | package → file | kind | size | restart | already handled by a plugin? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-llm-writable-request` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +18 −1 | yes | **yes — `dsh-context-reclaim`** |
| `agent-loop-snapshot-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +97 −20 | yes | no |
| `llm-pi-ai-system-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +96 −54 | yes | no |
| `compaction-pruner` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +354 −14 | yes | no |
| `ui-renderer-turntail` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` → `lib/client.js` | lines | +9 −1 | no | no |
| `ui-sidebar-wrap` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` → `lib/lib-client.js` | **regex** | +1 −1 | no | no |
| `session-format-v1-to-v2` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `session-persistence-jsonl` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `lib/worker.cjs` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `mcp-client` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +59 −6 | yes | no |
| `pi-ai-max-tokens-floor` | `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `dist/api/simple-options.js` | lines | +11 −1 | yes | no |

Every patch has its own `patches/<id>/NOTES.md` with **what it changes, when you want it, how to
verify it, and what to do if it does not fit your build** — in English and Chinese.

`ui-sidebar-wrap` is a **regex** patch on purpose: the sidebar's class prefix is a build hash, so a
line diff would be invalidated by any rebuild. `patches/<id>/change.json` stores the pattern and its
explicit inverse.

## Five ways to apply them

Pick whichever matches how you like to work. All five are documented step by step in
[`docs/methods.md`](docs/methods.md) (Chinese: [`docs/methods.zh-CN.md`](docs/methods.zh-CN.md)).

| | method | command |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | script (recommended) | `node apply.mjs --check` then `node apply.mjs --apply --all` |
| **B** | `git apply` | `cd <pkg dir> && git apply -p1 <library>/patches/<id>/change.diff` |
| **C** | your own AI agent | paste the block from [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and let it do A or B for you |
| **D** | regenerate for your build | `node tools/make-patch.mjs --file <patched> --orig <pristine> --pkg <pkg> --rel <rel>` |
| **E** | revert | `node apply.mjs --revert --all`, or restore any `*.orig` by hand |

All ten diffs were verified with `git apply -p1 --check` inside the package directory, so method B
works on every one of them.

### Method A in full

```bash
node apply.mjs --list                 # what is in here
node apply.mjs --roots                # which DSH installations were found on this machine
node apply.mjs --check                # per-file state: exact / applied / conflict / missing
node apply.mjs --apply --all          # apply everything that fits
node apply.mjs --apply --only mcp-client,compaction-pruner
node apply.mjs --revert --all         # put every .orig backup back
```

`--check` reports one of:

| state | meaning |
|---|---|
| `exact` | the file is the pristine version this library was built from — applying is safe |
| `applied` | the file already equals the patched version, nothing to do |
| `variant` | same version, different build (hash differs) but the hunks still fit — needs `--allow-variant`, or method D |
| `conflict` | the hunks do not fit. **Nothing is written.** Use method D to regenerate for your build |
| `missing` | that package is not part of the installation that was found |

### What the applier guarantees

* **It finds your installation, it does not assume one.** `--root`, `$DSH_APP_ROOT`,
  `$DSH_INSTALL_ROOT`, `$DSH_HOME` (including `profiles/*`), the running process's own DSH path,
  a `node` resolution from the current directory, and a bounded scan of the usual install locations
  for Windows / macOS / Linux — see `lib/discover.mjs`. `--root` means *exactly* that root, never
  that root plus whatever else was found.
* **`.orig` is sacred.** A backup is written once, next to the file, and never overwritten. If a
  `.orig` already exists, it is reused.
* **Every edit is syntax-checked.** `node --check` runs after each write; on failure the backup is
  restored immediately and the patch is reported as failed.
* **A hunk that does not fit is a conflict, never a guess.** The engine matches a hunk's old side
  exactly, exactly once, near the position it was recorded at.
* **It only writes inside the resolved root.** Nothing under `$DSH_HOME` is touched except, if you
  explicitly point `--root` at a profile directory, that profile's own `node_modules` copy of a
  package.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a requested action failed or conflicted, `2` no installation found.

## If you already run the four DSH plugins

You can skip `dsh-llm-writable-request` — `dsh-context-reclaim` takes over that path from inside the
plugin, with the official patch reverted. `--check` says so explicitly:

```
= dsh-llm-writable-request     already    node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js
    not needed: the dsh-context-reclaim plugin already handles this
```

The other nine are independent of the plugins: install neither, one, or both.

## Self-test

```bash
node verify.mjs
```

Offline, no DSH installation required. It checks that every diff parses and its hunk counts agree,
that the declared marker really is added by its patch, that the apply/revert engine round-trips on
synthetic samples, that a duplicated context is rejected instead of guessed, that the regex patch
round-trips through any class prefix — and that **no file in this repository contains a drive
letter, a personal home directory or a private workspace name** (that scan is part of the test
suite, not a promise).

`verify.mjs` finishes with a read-only `--check` summary of whatever installation it finds.

## Repository layout

```
apply.mjs             the applier: --list --roots --check --apply --revert --show
verify.mjs            offline self-test + personal-information scan
manifest.json         every patch's metadata: hashes, sizes, markers, risk, why, applyWhen
lib/manifest.mjs      manifest loading and schema checks
lib/discover.mjs      finds DSH installations (fully adaptive, platform-aware)
lib/unified.mjs       unified-diff parse / apply / revert engine
lib/backup.mjs        .orig backup and restore
lib/hash.mjs          sha256 helpers
patches/<id>/change.diff   the patch itself

plugins.description: Agent mode picker for DSH: choose an external Agent CLI as the session's default executor, with automatic discovery of installed CLIs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-picker

**Agent 模式选择器** —— 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 界面的输入框右侧加一个控件，
像选推理档位那样选定一个**外部 Agent CLI**作为当前会话的默认执行体。

它把"有哪些外部 Agent、各自怎么启动"做成**数据**（`agents.json`），
所以加一个新 Agent **只需加一条数据，不必改代码**。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 本身能调用外部 CLI，但"调哪一个"通常要写死在配置里。这个插件把选择权交回给你：
输入框右边一个下拉，选谁，这一轮就交给谁。名册驱动的设计意味着
**同一个插件能挂任意多个 Agent**，包括你自己写的。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-agent-picker
```

装完重启 DSH。插件第一次启动会把自带的 `agents.json` 复制一份到
`$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/`），**之后你改的是这一份**，
插件升级不会覆盖它。

## 名册：怎么加一个新 Agent

编辑 `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json`，往 `agents` 数组里加一条：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 唯一标识 |
| `name` | 显示名 |
| `tool` | DSH 里对应的工具名 |
| `bin` | 包装器文件名（用于"是否已安装"的探测） |
| `available` | 初始可用性建议；**真实可用性由插件探测包装器是否存在** |
| `kind` | `task`=任务型（结果可概括）／`chat`=对话型（原样转述） |
| `expertise` | 菜单里显示的「擅长」一行 |
| `note` | 健康状态／接线说明 |
| `desc` | 展开后的详细能力介绍 |
| `launch` | **可选**。自带执行配方：`bin` / `argv` / `env` / `timeoutMs` / `graceMs` / `maxBytes`。写了它，本插件就自己注册 `cli_<id>_direct` 工具 |

改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

### `launch.argv` 的路径规则（重要）

名册是**跨机器**的，所以**不要写死绝对路径**。`argv` 里写**裸文件名**即可，
插件会在运行时按下面顺序解析：

```
codex-dsh.ps1            ->  <cliBinDir>/codex-dsh.ps1
{cliDir}/codex-dsh.ps1   ->  <cliBinDir>/codex-dsh.ps1
C:\some\where\x.ps1      ->  原样保留（你想钉死绝对路径时用）
```

`cliBinDir` 的取值：环境变量 **`DSH_AGENT_PICKER_CLI_DIR`** 优先，
否则默认 `~/dsh-clis/bin`（与 `dsh-sub-cli` 的约定一致）。

### 占位符

`argv` 里可用的占位符：`{task}`（任务正文）、`{permission}`、`{model}`、`{image}`。

**`{image}` 只对命令行真的支持图片参数的 CLI 有意义**（例如 Codex 的 `-i/--image`）。
其余 CLI 就算它自己有读图能力，也**不是**靠这个占位符——那种情况请把图片路径写进任务正文，
让那个 Agent 用自己的读文件工具去读。

## 你需要自备什么

这个插件**只负责调度，不附带任何 Agent**。要用哪个，请自行安装并确认它在命令行可用：

Claude Code · Codex · Qwen Code · Gemini CLI · Aider · Goose · Hermes · OpenClaw · Ollama …

插件按 `cliBinDir` 下的包装器探测可用性；**探测不到的成员不会出现在可选区**。

> 封装脚本的写法与各 CLI 的接入细节，取决于你接哪个模型端点、有哪些凭据。
> 这部分**不在本插件范围内**，请按你自己的环境准备。

## 参数约定

所有 Agent 工具的正文参数统一叫 **`prompt`**（配一个 3–5 词的 `description` 作标题；
`task` 是兼容别名）。新加 Agent 请沿用，别另起名字。

## 兼容性

`dsh.compatibility` 声明为 `>=0.1.5`。
本插件**不依赖** `settings.register()` / `installSection()` 这类会随宿主版本变动的设置 API ——
它只用 `ctx.tools.register` / `ctx.tools.guard` / `ctx.subprocess` / `ctx.webServer.register`。

> 背景：DSH 0.1.7 移除了旧的 settings 注册入口，凡是用到它的插件会在启动时抛
> `TypeError: ... is not a function`。本插件从设计上避开了这条路径。

## 安全声明（请务必读）

**这个插件的本质是：按你的配置，在本机启动外部程序并执行任务。**

它不是沙箱，也不是审核者。请清楚以下几点：

### 1. 它具备"在本机执行程序"的能力

被选为默认执行体后，插件会启动对应的 CLI 进程，并**继承你的用户权限**（能读写你能读写的文件）。
所以"把任务交给哪个 Agent"这件事，等同于"允许哪个程序在你这台机器上干活"。

### 2. 三条可能的滥用面

| 面 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **名册文件** | `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json` 里 `launch.bin` / `launch.argv` 写什么，插件就执行什么。**拿到该文件写权限的人，等于拿到本机执行权。** |
| **约定目录** | `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.d/*.agent.json` 是**任何程序都能丢文件进来**的落地目录。它带来的正是"装了就自动出现"的便利，也是它的风险面。 |
| **自动探测** | 插件会在 `PATH`、`cliBinDir`、`~/.local/bin` 里找已知名字的命令（`codex` / `claude` / `aider` …）。**同目录下放一个同名恶意程序，就会被选中。** |

### 3. 插件做了什么缓解

- 启动子进程时**剥离敏感环境变量**：名字里含 `KEY` / `TOKEN` / `SECRET` / `PASSWORD` 一类的一律不传，
  且**所有 `DSH_*` 一律不传**（避免把会话身份交给外部进程）。
- 每个 Agent 都有**超时上限**（默认 15 分钟，可按成员覆盖）与**输出上限**（默认 200,000 字节），
  防止一个挂住的子进程拖垮会话。
- 缺环境变量或需要常驻服务的 Agent，会标为"待配置"而**不是**静默执行。

### 4. 你的责任

- 用之前**看一眼** `agent-picker.agents.json` 和 `agent-picker.d/` 里到底有什么
- **只安装你信任的 Agent CLI**。插件不审核、不签名、也不沙箱化它们
- 不要把名册文件或约定目录**共享给不可信的人或程序**
- 若你在多用户机器上使用，注意 `$DSH_HOME` 的目录权限

> 一句话：**你交给它多少个 Agent，就等于打开了多少条本机执行通道。** 请按这个前提使用。

## 许可

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-agent-picker contributors

你可以自由使用、修改、再分发（保留版权声明即可）。本插件**不附带任何 Agent**，
调度的是你自己安装的第三方 CLI，那些工具各自的许可与费用由你自行遵守。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ok541151/cwk.git
cd cwk
```

离线自检脚本依赖宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`。若在仓库外单独跑断言，
需要在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` 下指向宿主那份（**这个目录不要提交**）。

plugins.description: Cited for DeepSeek Harness: search your documents and answer with citations. Install by pasting this repository in Plugins.
plugins.readme_text:
Ask your Cited documents from DeepSeek Harness and get the source with every answer.

[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-171717)](LICENSE) [![dsh-tools peer range](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--tools-0.1%20%2F%200.2-171717)](#compatibility) [![CI](https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![Status: early development](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-early%20development-DDF469?labelColor=171717) [English](README.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [中文](README.zh.md) - Keep your documents in Cited while you work in your agent. - Check answers against numbered source passages. - Choose document search or a full cited answer. **Cited inside DeepSeek Harness.** Two native tools let your agent search a [Cited](https://github.com/RonnieGex/cited) installation and answer from its documents with numbered citations. The plugin connects to your configured installation over `POST /api/mcp`. **Early development.** Installation and a real cited answer have been exercised headlessly. See the dated [compatibility table](#compatibility) for verification limits. [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Real answer](#a-real-answer) · [Install](#install) · [Configure](#configure) · [Tools](#the-two-tools) · [Token](#your-token) · [Compatibility](#compatibility) · [Development](#development) · [License](#license) ## How it works 1. Run `dsh plugin add github:RonnieGex/dsh-cited`. 2. Open the plugin configuration and set **url** and **token**. 3. Ask your agent. It calls `cited_search` or `cited_ask` and answers with `[1]`. Cited hosts documents and retrieval. DeepSeek Harness hosts the agent and this plugin. No MCP client row in `cordis.yml` is needed for these native tools. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness within the [declared peer range](#compatibility). - A running Cited server with MCP enabled and its token. - Node `>=22.19`; development and evidence use Node 24. ## A real answer > Yes. Every repair carries a **90-day guarantee on the work**, and parts carry the guarantee of their maker [1]. **3 of 3 English questions received a supported guarantee citation** from an English document. The earlier batch behind the Spanish example scored **2 of 3**: its two Spanish questions succeeded, while its English question missed the Spanish price passage. Keyword search without embeddings can miss a Spanish passage when asked in English. Recorded on 2026-10-09 with the plugin installed from GitHub main in temporary headless state. The image shows the selected `cited_ask` exchange and the complete English answer, with its own source highlighted inside TOOL RESULT. Terminal Markdown stays raw. The [English transcript](docs/evidence/headless-answer-en.txt), [English outcomes](docs/evidence/natural-summary-en.json), [Spanish-example outcomes](docs/evidence/natural-summary.json) and [verification details](docs/evidence/compatibility.md) preserve the evidence and limits. ## Install Run the verified installation command: ```sh dsh plugin add github:RonnieGex/dsh-cited ``` In the desktop app, use **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste `https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited` (not click-tested; see Compatibility). The repository ships `lib/`: installation needs no compilation or `allowBuilds` permission. ## Configure Open the plugin configuration: | Field | Value | |---|---| | `url` | Your Cited address, such as `https://cited.example.com`. The plugin appends `/api/mcp`, or preserves it when already present. Query strings and fragments are dropped. | | `token` | The server's `CITED_MCP_TOKEN`. Marked as a secret field. | | `timeoutMs` | Positive call timeout in milliseconds; **30000** by default. | Without a server token, Cited’s MCP endpoint is off. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`, set it as `CITED_MCP_TOKEN` on the Cited server (see the [MCP guide](https://github.com/RonnieGex/cited/blob/main/docs/mcp.md)), and enter the same value in the plugin. Keep it out of prompts, screenshots and Git. `url` and `token` start empty so you can install before configuring. A call reports the missing field as a tool error without breaking the harness. After filling both, ask your agent to search a phrase present in your documents. ## The two tools | Tool | Input | Result | |---|---|---| | `cited_search` | `query: string`, `limit?: integer` from **1 to 8**, default **5** | `{ passages: [{ n, document, heading, position, excerpt }] }` | | `cited_ask` | `question: string`, `sessionId?: string` | `{ status, answer, citations }`; status is `answered` or `refused` | **Search, then let your agent answer.** `cited_search` retrieves passages without calling Cited's answer model. Each has its source and citation number. No matches means no passages, not an invented answer. The calling agent's model and any configured embedding provider can still incur charges. **Let Cited write the answer.** `cited_ask` invokes Cited's answering pipeline and returns a cited answer or an explicit refusal. Citations have the passage fields above plus `lead`, the overlap length. The text result includes each source's document, section, position and exact excerpt. Reuse `sessionId` to persist a conversation and its thread on Cited. This can consume that server's model budget. ## Your token - Sent as `Authorization: Bearer` to the configured endpoint; not added to tool arguments or normal output. - Marked secret in the configuration schema for the harness's field handling. This does not establish encryption at rest. Protect the configuration; use HTTPS for remote servers. - Redacted from transport failures, together with URL credentials. Rejected authorization, disabled endpoint, timeout and unreachable host become short tool errors. - The plugin owns no document database. Cited stores documents and conversations created through `cited_ask` with a `sessionId`. ## Troubleshooting | Error | Fix | |---|---| | Missing `url` or `token` | Fill in the named field in the plugin configuration. | | `404` from Cited | Check `url`, set `CITED_MCP_TOKEN` on that server and restart it. | | `401` from Cited | Make `token` match the server’s `CITED_MCP_TOKEN`. | | Timeout | Check the host and network, then raise `timeoutMs` if needed. | ## Compatibility Declared `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` peer range: ```text >=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.0 <0.3.0-0 ``` A range is not proof of every version. MCP clients below connect directly to **Cited**, without this native plugin. | Client | Date | Evidence and limit | |---|---|---| | DeepSeek Harness 0.1.6-alpha.2 | 2026-10-09 | GitHub main plugin installation and three supported English guarantee answers in isolated headless state. [Record](docs/evidence/headless-answer-en.json); [gate](evidence/gate.txt). | | DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, bundled CLI | 2026-10-09 | Installed and answered in a local run on 2026-10-09; raw log not kept in this repository. [Provenance](docs/evidence/compatibility.md). | | Claude Code → Cited MCP | 2026-10-09 | Prior verification: connected and listed both tools. No model tool call claimed. [Provenance](docs/evidence/compatibility.md). | | Codex → Cited MCP | 2026-10-09 | Prior verification

plugins.description: A judgment kernel for coding agents: routine judgments go to a small Jev judge, and every verdict is recorded in a ledger.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jev-judge

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A judgment kernel for coding agents. The small, frequent calls an agent makes —
does this tool output matter, did anything actually verify that claim, does this
page carry instructions aimed at the model, did the user really ask for this
command — go to a small judge instead of the main model. The agent keeps its
context and its tokens for the work that needs reasoning.

> **Read the scope before installing.** This layer treats a *context budget*, not
> code quality or execution speed: it takes no part in compiling, caching or
> optimising, and changes only what the model sees. Measured over 55 days of real
> sessions on the machine it was written on — context windows of 262k–1M, zero
> pressure-triggered compactions, zero injection hits, and 0.4/day of the one
> decision point that maps onto an outcome — **it was uninstalled there**. See
> [R10 of `docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md). It earns its place when
> the host's context really is scarce, or when the output is mostly *scanned*
> rather than worked on: shell logs, introspection dumps, browser snapshots.

It runs in **DeepSeek Harness** as a plugin bundle, in **Claude Code**, **Codex**
and **OpenCode** through command hooks or MCP, and anywhere else that can start
an MCP server or run a command.

## Why a kernel

An agent loop makes dozens of small judgments per run. Handing every one to the
main model is slow and expensive; encoding every one as a fixed rule breaks on
real input. This package is the layer in between: one bounded question over a
small state, answered by a small judge, consumed by code that owns the
thresholds, the fallbacks and the final action.

The design follows [`mu`](https://github.com/qybaihe/mu), which loads a judgment
kernel into the `pi` coding agent. What this project adds is reach: the kernel is
host-free, so the same decision points run in agents that `mu` does not cover.
[`docs/mu-analysis.md`](docs/mu-analysis.md) is the study, including the wording
discipline and the measurements behind it.

## Install

### DeepSeek Harness

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-jev-judge
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config   # shows the layer
```

Or install it from **Settings → Plugins** in the Web GUI, by registry name, git
address or local path.

### Everything else

- **Claude Code / Codex** — command hooks in `settings.json` / `hooks.json`.
- **OpenCode, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline** — the MCP server.

```sh
claude mcp add jev-judge -- npx -y dsh-jev-judge mcp
```

[`docs/agents.md`](docs/agents.md) has the exact configuration for each host and
what a verdict is able to do in each.

## What it decides

| Decision point | The question | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `judge.items` | One yes/no question asked of many items — hundreds of log lines, files or findings, without reading them all | on when called |
| `tool.admission` | Which chunks of a long tool result are needed for this task, so the rest never enters the context | `active` |
| `tool.injection` | Which passages of fetched content read as instructions aimed at the model rather than material for a reader | `active` |
| `turn.completion` | Does this "it's done" claim have anything that verified it | `active` |
| `turn.continue` | Did the turn stop in front of a step it announced, or ask for a go-ahead it already had | `active` |
| `memory.capture` | Is this message a correction worth keeping, or just the next task | `active` |
| `tool.risk` | For a command the rules already flagged: did the user actually ask for this | `shadow` |

Every point carries a deterministic fallback equal to the behaviour without this
package, and every verdict is written to a ledger — which is how a point earns
`active` from real sessions instead of from optimism.

`tool.risk` starts in `shadow` on purpose: its verdict can only loosen policy, so
it has to earn that from your own ledger before it is allowed to.

## Configure

The provider is a private record you own, in the format published by the
[`typesafe-ai-jev-skill`](https://github.com/HunterXing/typesafe-ai-jev-skill)
Agent Skill:

```text
$JEV_SKILL_CONFIG  →  ~/.config/typesafe-ai-jev-skill.json
```

```json
{
  "providerName": "your-provider",
  "baseUrl": "https://api.your-provider.example",
  "model": "jev",
  "apiKeyEnv": "JEV_API_KEY",
  "protocol": "systemone",
  "endpointPath": "v1/systemone",
  "authHeader": "Authorization",
  "authScheme": "Bearer",
  "timeoutSeconds": 30
}
```

```sh
jev-judge verify    # offline; reports the contract, never the key
jev-judge doctor    # what will happen: judges, modes, ledger
```

Kernel settings, all optional, live in `~/.config/jev-judge/kernel.json`:

```json
{
  "modes": { "default": "shadow", "tool.admission": "active" },
  "routes": { "turn.continue": ["jev"] },
  "tiers": ["jev"],
  "ledger": { "path": "~/.config/jev-judge/ledger.ndjson", "recordState": false },
  "options": { "judge.items": { "maxItems": 20 } },
  "timeoutMs": 8000
}
```

`jev-judge ledger` reads the ledger; `--json` prints the records as stored.

### Admission only thins what is *scanned*

`tool.admission` acts by default only on output whose size nobody chose: a log, a
dump, a listing, a page. The default list:

```json
["bash", "cordis_inspect_*", "mcp__*", "web_fetch", "webfetch", "web_search", "websearch", "fetch"]
```

`read`, `grep`, `glob`, `skill`, `write`, `edit` — the tools whose *shape* the
agent asked for — pass through whole. Thinning one of those saves tokens and
buys a re-read that may come back thinned differently. Names match without case
(`bash` and Claude Code's `Bash` are the same tool), and a trailing `*` matches a
prefix.

```json
{ "options": { "admission": { "toolNames": ["bash", "mcp__*"], "minChars": 4000 } } }
```

In DeepSeek Harness this goes in the plugin row's `config.options`, i.e. the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

## Design rules

- **A verdict never decides that the agent should ask the user something.** It
  changes what the model sees, or whether it keeps working.
- **No verdict means the behaviour you would have had without this package.**
- **Small state, bounded question.** The judge reads summaries and metadata, not
  bulk text; a `choice` question always carries an escape answer.
- **One predicate per question.** Compound questions are split and combined in
  the policy — measured, not assumed ([`docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md)).
- **Shadow first.** A point whose verdict can only loosen policy starts there.
- **Fail open.** A judge that is slow, unreachable or unsure yields the fallback,
  never a stalled agent loop.
- **The key never leaves your private record** — not into a log, a ledger record,
  an error message, or a chat.

## Measured

From [`docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md), on a real 81-line test log
with two failures, judged by the live provider 20 items per call:

- 81 lines → 5 selected, **191 of 3047 bytes (6.3%)** need reading, 7.9 s;
- the same log with the question aimed at fixing rather than triage selected the
  assertion message and the error text instead of the summary line.

## Development

No runtime dependencies and no build step, on purpose: the package loads straight
from a checkout, so `dsh plugin add <path>` needs no build-script approval.

```sh
node --test              # 217 tests, no network
node src/cli.js --help
```

Releases are cut by pushing a version tag: `.github/workflows/release.yml`
publishes to npm through trusted publishing (no token in the repository) after
the same suite passes. See [`docs/market.md`](docs/market.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). TypeSafe, System One and Jev belong to their respective rights
holders; this project is not affiliated with them. The judgment-kernel design is
adapted from [`mu`](https://github.com/qybaihe/mu) (MIT) — see
[ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏实时余额 + 每轮对话花费（人民币，含 token 明细）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-usage

一个 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件，做两件事：

1. **侧边栏余额**：在左下角「设置」旁边实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（默认每 60 秒刷新；点击可展开充值余额 / 赠送余额并手动刷新；侧栏收窄成图标栏时显示为彩色状态点）。
2. **每轮对话花费**：在每一轮对话底部的信息栏里额外显示**这一轮花了多少钱**，点击可展开三列明细（项目 / tokens / 单价）。

> 只适用于**官方 DeepSeek（`deepseek-official`）** 且在**带 Web 界面的 profile**（`desktop` 或 `web`）里使用。用其他 provider 时余额读不到、也不该按 DeepSeek 价目计价。

## 关于安装入口（曾踩过的坑）

部分第三方桌面客户端内置的「插件市场」有一条硬性边界：**只接受 `包名@精确版本` 这种 npm 目标**，`github:` 源、`file:` 路径、裸包名一律拒绝。遇到这种客户端时，市场的报错大致是：

> 这个桌面客户端只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件，而该插件仅提供 GitHub 源，因此装不了——这是客户端的安装边界，不是插件或市场的问题。可以改用普通 dsh web 安装，或请插件作者发布 npm 包。

**本插件现已发布到 npm**（`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`），因此这条边界不再是问题：用「方式一」或「方式二」都能装。如果市场仍报上面的错，说明你用的市场缓存了旧目录，或你点的是插件的 GitHub 条目而不是 npm 条目。

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux 均可（本插件不含平台相关代码，未使用任何平台专有 API） |
| dsh | 带 Web 界面的 profile（官方桌面版或 `dsh web`）；headless / SDK profile 没有 webserver，插件不会生效 |
| Node.js | ≥ 22.19（宿主读取余额用 `fetch` 与 `AbortSignal.timeout`） |
| DeepSeek 凭据 | 官方 provider 的 API Key，存在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或同名环境变量 |
| 依赖 | **零运行时依赖**：host 半不 import 任何包，client 半只向 dsh 的模块表要 `react` |

## 安装

包名是 **`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`**（带 scope，因为 npm 上 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 已被无关项目占用）。

### 方式一：命令行从 npm 安装（推荐）

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add @blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
```

**装完重启 dsh。**

### 方式二：从图形插件市场安装

市场只会把 `包名@精确版本` 交给客户端，所以本插件**发布到 npm 之后**可以从市场一键安装——在市场的搜索框里找 `dsh-deepseek-usage`，或直接粘贴上面的完整包名。

> 如果你在市场里看到过「只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件，而该插件仅提供 GitHub 源」这样的提示，说明你用的是**本插件还没有 npm 版本时**的市场状态，或者你点的是插件的 GitHub 条目。请改用方式一，或先确认版本。

### 方式三：从 GitHub 源码安装（无需 npm）

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
```

pnpm 默认会拦截 Git 依赖的构建脚本。本插件**没有任何编译步骤**，但仍带一个 `prepare` 安装钩子（`tools/prepare.mjs`）用于完整性检查；若安装时被拦下，按提示在该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage': true
```

> ⚠️ `allowBuilds` 表示**允许该包的安装脚本在你的机器上执行**。本插件的钩子只做一件事：检查四个关键文件存在且非空，缺任何一个就拒绝安装——它不编译、不下载、不访问网络。**授权前请先读一遍 `tools/prepare.mjs`。** 想更稳妥可锁定 commit：`github:BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage#<sha>`。

### 方式四：从 Releases 下载 tarball（无需 Git、无需 npm、无需授权脚本）

每个版本都会在 [Releases](https://github.com/BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage/releases) 附上 `blackthunder2191026-dsh-deepseek-usage-<版本>.tgz`：

```sh
# 下载后在下载目录执行
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./blackthunder2191026-dsh-deepseek-usage-1.0.0.tgz
```

### ⚠️ 从旧版本（不带 scope 的 `dsh-deepseek-usage`）升级

包名换了，dsh 会把它当成**两个不同的插件**，同时装会让界面出现两套余额栏。升级前先移除旧包：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-deepseek-usage
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add @blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
# 然后重启 dsh
```

### 所有方式都要做的一步

**重启 dsh。** 包 manifest、`exports`、profile 的 bundle 列表都不参与热重载；只改 `lib/client.js` 时刷新页面即可，改了 `lib/index.js`（host 半）就必须重启。

## 验证安装是否成功

```sh
# 1) 装之前：包结构自检，不需要 dsh 在运行
npm run verify

# 2) 装好后：profile 里应出现该 bundle，且路由可访问
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<你的端口>/deepseek-usage/summary?debug=1"
```

第 2 步应返回 `{"ok":true,...,"balance":{...}}`，带 `debug=1` 时还会给出折叠诊断（是否找到会话、读了多少事件、算出多少轮）。`debug.diagnostics.reason` 是 `ok` 就说明这条链是通的。

**`npm run verify` 包含三个彼此独立的检查**，都不依赖你的 profile，也不发起网络请求：

| 脚本 | 检查什么 |
|---|---|
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 浏览器半能加载、两个 slot 注册成功、展开明细按真实 payload 渲染（含表头、单价、空值占位） |
| `tools/verify-render.mjs` | 用桩路由 + 每实例一套 hook 状态的桩 React，断言两个座位在真实数据下渲染正确（金额、tokens、未计价轮次文案、`TurnLocation` 形状兼容） |
| `tools/verify-composition.mjs --source` | 复刻 dsh 的解析链：manifest 的 `dsh.client` / `exports["./client"]` / 产物里的模块 id / bundle patch 的行 id 三者一致 |

维护者另外还有一条 `npm run selfcheck`：发布前扫描所有文件，检查是否混入本机绝对路径、用户名、疑似密钥，以及 `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs`/`author` 等发布元数据是否齐全。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 图形市场里点安装失败，提示「只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件」 | 该客户端只接受 `包名@精确版本`。用「安装」方式一（npm）或方式四（tarball）；若仍报错，是市场缓存了旧目录 |
| 界面上出现两套余额栏 | 旧的 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 与新的 `@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage` 同时装着。见「从旧版本升级」一节 |
| 侧边栏没有余额行 | 该 profile 没有 webserver 或不是 Web 界面；或 host 半未激活。先看 `?debug=1` 有没有响应 |
| 余额显示不可用 | 没有 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或你用的不是官方 DeepSeek provider |
| 每轮只显示「本轮进行中，结束后计价」 | 该轮尚未结束（正常）；若显示「本轮未计价（宿主已算到第 N 轮）」则是异常，请反馈那一整行 |
| 启动时报 `declares no dsh.bundle` | 包没装全，或安装链接损坏；重新安装 |
| 安装时报 ENOENT 指向某 tgz | 你删掉了 profile 正在引用的 tarball；重新 `pnpm pack` 并按原路径放回，或重新安装 |
| 改了代码不生效 | host 半需重启 dsh；client 半需刷新页面（强刷 Ctrl+F5） |

## 维护者注：发布与续版

包名是 scope 形式（`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`），scope 不会与任何人冲突——npm 上无 scope 的 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 是无关项目，不能用那个名字。

```sh
npm login                     # 首次需浏览器认证
npm publish                   # publishConfig.access=public 已配置，scoped 包也会公开发布
```

**发布前必看**：`package.json` 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml` 里行的 `name`、`lib/client.js` 中 `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 这三处必须是**同一个字符串**。任何一处不一致，要么插件根本不挂载，要么浏览器侧静默不加载（表现为侧边栏和对话底部都没有东西，且不报错）。`npm run selfcheck` 与 `npm run verify:package` 都会检查这一点。

续版流程：改 `version` → `npm run verify && npm run selfcheck` → `npm publish` → 打 tag 推 GitHub → 重新 `pnpm pack` 并把新 tgz 传到 Release。

## 计费口径

- 数据来自**会话日志里 provider 真实上报的 usage**（`assistant/message.usage`），不是界面上的估算值。
- 每轮按以下公式计价（价格单位：元 / 百万 tokens）：

  ```
  花费(CNY) = 未命中输入 × miss价
            + (缓存命中输入 + 缓存写入) × hit价
            + 输出 × output价
  ```

  价目表来自**官方中文定价页**（<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>），单位就是**元 / 百万 tokens**，与余额同币种。缓存写入按未命中价计。

  > 早期版本用的是**英文页的美元表**，再乘一个 `usdToCny`（我当时填 7.1）换成人民币。那是错的：中文页并不是英文页的固定换算——`0.02/0.003 = 6.6667`（Flash）而 `0.15/0.022 = 6.8182`（Pro），是**各自独立定价**。用 7.1 去折美元表，得到的数字官方两边都对不上（实测偏高约 6%）。现在直接采用中文页的元价，**插件里不再有任何汇率**。
- 高峰/低谷自动判断：高峰为**北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00**（即 01:00–04:00 与 06:00–10:00 UTC），其余时段（含周末）为低谷，费率为高峰的一半。中国法定节假日无法自动识别，那几天会按高峰计（偏高）。
- 花费与余额同为人民币，可直接相减；**没有任何汇率换算**。
- **只有已经结束的轮次才计价**（日志里 `turn/end` 已落盘）。进行中的这一轮显示「花费统计中…」，结束后自动出现金额。
- API Key 只在 Host 侧经 `ctx.credentials` 读取（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或同名环境变量），**不会下发到浏览器**；浏览器只请求同源的 `/deepseek-usage/summary`。

## 关于本机 profile 的两点提醒

> **必须重启 dsh 进程**：包 manifest、`exports`、profile bundle 列表都不参与热重载；只有同一路径下 `lib/client.js` 内容变化（配 `tsdown --watch` 之类 watcher）才走 client HMR。
>
> **tarball 方式安装后别删那个 tgz**：profile 的 `package.json` 会用 `file:` 指向它，删了它 pnpm 下次安装会报 ENOENT。

## 改配置

行 id 是 `deepseek-usage`。改配置走 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— **整段替换，不是深合并**，要重述全部需要的键：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-usage
  name: dsh-deepseek-usage
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # 凭据引用名，同时作为环境变量名
    baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
    currency: CNY                 # 余额币种；价目表也用这个币种，不做换算
    balanceTtlMs: 30000           # 余额缓存时长
    defaultModel: deepseek-flash  # 价目表里没有的模型用哪一行
    maxTurns: 300                 # 单次返回的最大轮次数
    models:                       # 元 / 百万 tokens（官方中文定价页）
      deepseek-flash:
        hit:    { peak: 0.04, offPeak: 0.02 }
        miss:   { peak: 2,    offPeak: 1 }
        output: { peak: 8,    offPeak: 4 }
      deepseek-v4-pro:
        hit:    { peak: 0.3,  offPeak: 0.15 }
        miss:   { peak: 9,    offPeak: 4.5 }
        output: { peak: 27,   offPeak: 13.5 }
```

价格随 DeepSeek 官方调整而变，请对照 <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/> 更新 `models`。**注意别用英文页的美元价**——两页不是固定汇率关系。

## 实现结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半：`GET /user/balance` 取余额；按会话日志折叠每轮 token 并计价；注册 `GET /deepseek-usage/summary` |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：手写 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂（无构建步骤），注册 `sidebar.footer.action` 与 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 两个 slot |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：插入 `deepseek-usage` 行并带默认配置与价目表 |
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 用假 loader / 假 cordis context 跑 client bundle：断言两个 slot 注册、首屏渲染，并把一份价格化的轮次推过展开明细 |
| `tools/verify-render.mjs` | 起一个桩 `/deepseek-usage/summary` 路由 + 每实例一套 hook 状态的桩 React，断言两个座位渲染出真实 payload（金额、tokens、未计价轮次文案） |
| `tools/verify-composition.mjs` | 复刻 `client-modules` 的解析链：profile bundle 列表 → Loader 解析归属 manifest → `dsh.client` 声明与 `./client` 产物 → `inject` 依赖可解析 → patch 行 id/name/config 与 host 导出一致 |
| `tools/verify-turns.mjs` | 解压真实 `.jsonl.zstd` 会话日志（多帧 zstd）并打印逐轮折叠结果 |

Host 半的每轮折叠是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` 里 `deriveTurnTokenUsage` 的等价实现，差别在于它保留每次 attempt 各自的 `provider/model` 路由，因此混合模型的会话也能逐轮正确计价。

## 自检

```sh

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn a YouTube link into study notes — captions, on-screen content via vision, then your own notes merged in.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-youtube-study-notes

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that turns a YouTube link into study notes — and then gets *your* notes involved.

Give it a link. It pulls the video's own captions, samples the frames so it can read what was on screen, **stops and asks what you took from it**, and merges all three into one document.

The middle step is the point. Every other video-to-notes tool produces the same summary for everyone. This one writes the notes you'd have written, if you'd been taking notes.

## What it does

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Captions** — `yt-dlp` fetches the caption track YouTube already publishes. Human-written preferred, auto-generated as fallback. No ASR, no third-party transcript sites. |
| 2 | **Outline** — the timestamped transcript is read in full and outlined by chapter. |
| 3 | **Visual pass** *(optional)* — `ffmpeg` scene-change detection samples one frame per shot; a vision model reads the on-screen text. Catches slides, code, formulas and diagrams the narration never says out loud. |
| 4 | **Ask** — the agent stops and asks what *you* noticed, in your words. Type it or dictate it. |
| 5 | **Merge** — transcript + on-screen evidence + your observations, into one markdown file. |
| 6 | **Save** — `notes.md`, written beside the transcript so the evidence stays with it. |
| 7 | **Clean up** — the frame stills and any video file are removed; the transcript stays. |

### What it leaves on disk

The video is never kept: step 3 downloads it into a temporary directory that is deleted
when the script exits (`--keep-video` is the only way it survives). The frame JPEGs are
removed by step 7 once `notes.md` exists — they are derived from someone else's video and
are typically tens of megabytes, against a few kilobytes of transcript.

Kept, because it is the evidence behind every spoken claim and costs almost nothing:

```
transcript.md  transcript.txt  meta.json  notes.md
```

`cleanup.py` refuses to act on a directory that does not carry one of those markers, so
it cannot be pointed at an unrelated folder. Pass `--keep-frames` to review the stills
yourself.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-youtube-study-notes
```

Restart the profile afterwards — bundle changes apply at boot.

Then trigger it either way:

```
/youtube-study-notes https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID
```

or just ask in plain language ("get me notes from this video: …"). A link plus a request
for notes, a summary, or study material is enough.

> **Desktop clients:** the desktop app manages its own profile. Use its **Plugins → Add
> plugin** flow rather than the CLI, and enable the bundle when the install finishes.

## Requirements

The plugin ships no runtime code — its substance is the Skill, which drives local tools.
`dsh` does not install these for you:

| Tool | Role | Install |
|---|---|---|
| `python3` | runs the bundled scripts (standard library only) | `brew install python3` |
| `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` | audio/video probing, scene detection, frame extraction | `brew install ffmpeg` |
| `yt-dlp` | caption listing and download | `brew install yt-dlp` |

The Skill detects missing tools, names them, and waits for your confirmation before
installing anything.

## Enabling the visual pass

Step 3 needs a model that accepts images, and **many model entries do not** — even ones
whose name says "vision". A model is only offered images if its configuration declares
`input: [text, image]`; entries otherwise default to `["text"]`, and the harness refuses
the image before attaching it with:

```
model "<provider>/<model>" does not declare image input
```

The Skill handles this: it tries `read_image` on a single frame first. If the session
model can see images, it reads the frames directly. If not, it delegates through the
`workflow` tool's per-agent `provider` / `model` override, and asks you once which
image-capable model to use.

To make a model explicitly image-capable, declare it in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` (the file your profile tells you to edit — not `cordis.yml`):

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      your-provider:
        # ...existing provider config...
        models:
          - id: "your-vision-model"
            name: "Your Vision Model"
            contextWindow: 200000
            input:
              - text
              - image
```

A profile with live reload picks this up without a restart.

> **Only declare this if the endpoint actually serves images.** Over-claiming admits an
> image the provider then rejects mid-turn, after the message is already durable. The
> declaration is not verified for you.

**If you skip all of this**, the plugin still works — it just produces transcript-only
notes, and says so rather than pretending it saw the screen.

## Limitations

- **Caption-less videos stop the run.** If a video publishes no caption track at all
  (not even auto-generated), step 1 reports which video failed and stops. Nothing is
  invented to fill the gap. Pair this with a local speech-to-text plugin if you need
  those covered.
- **Auto-generated captions are rough** — no punctuation, misheard proper nouns. The
  skill always reports which kind it got.
- **Vision reads can be wrong at the character level.** A period can read as a hyphen,
  `1` as `l`. Fine for prose, worth double-checking in code and formulas. The skill is
  instructed to flag anything load-bearing that looks ambiguous.
- **Frame sampling sees shots, not motion.** A diagram built up over one continuous shot
  yields a single frame.
- **Personal study use.** Captions, frames and notes are derived from someone else's
  work. Don't republish them.

## How it's built

```
package.json          declares dsh.bundle → cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml      inserts one @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem row
lib/index.js          resolveSkillRoot() — resolves skills/ from the profile's own module identity
skills/youtube-study-notes/
  SKILL.md            the workflow
  scripts/            yt_transcript.py, video_frames.py, cleanup.py
  references/         notes template and merge rules
```

The bundle mounts its `skills/` directory as an **isolated** provider
(`includeDefaultRoots: false`), so installing it contributes exactly one skill and
cannot shadow or reorder the ones you already have.
